Make,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓkf 8 U, vi-DA 3 U, anu-zWA 1 P, Acar 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 (Create) nirmA 3 A, 2 P, sfj 6 P, Gaw c., (Gawayati), kf, vi-DA, rac 10, kxp c., utpad c., jan c. (janayati), sAD c., niH-saM-pad c.
Ⓑ
 3 (Produce) utpad c., jan c., kf; See Cause.
Ⓑ
 4 (Force) ex. by causal of roots; ‘m(ake)s me question you’ praSnakarmaRi mAM niyo-jayati (Ka. 134); See Compel.
Ⓑ
 5 nirmA, Gaw c.; gen. ex. by nirmita, Gawita, rUpa, maya, Atmaka in comp.; also by BU 1 P, saM-pad 4 A; ‘10 repeated 2 times m(ake)s 20’ dvirAvfttA daSa viMSatirBavaMti or saMpadyaMte.
Ⓑ
 6 Ap 5 P, vid 6 U, laB 1 A; See Get; ‘m(ake) amends for’ kzatiM pUr 10, pratiPalaM dA 3 U, pramfj 2 P, nizkf; ‘m(ake) account of’ man 4 A or c., gaR 10, apekz 1 A; ‘to m(ake) the best of a bad matter’ dozamapi guRatvamApAdayituM; ‘self-made man’ svodyamalabDapratizWaH; ‘m(ake) merry’ hfzwa a. BU, utsatvaM kf; ‘m(ake) much of’ bahu man; ‘m(ake) light of’ tfRAya man or gaR, laGUkf, avajYA 9 U; See Contemn; ‘m(ake) way’ aMtaraM dA; apa-sf 1 P, apa-i-yA 2 P; apakram 1 U, 4 P; ‘m(ake) free with’ saMkocaM tyaktvA Acar or vyavahf 1 P; ‘m(ake) away with’ naS c., vyA-pad c., han 2 P or c. [] (GAtayati); See Kill; ‘m(ake) water’ mUtrotsargaM kf; ‘m(ake) good’ pA c. (pAlayati), pUr 10, tF 1 P, rakz 1 P (promise &c.); See Fulfil also; saM-pad c., sAD 5 P or c.; (loss) pUr, prativiDA 3 U, pratikf, apAkf, SuD c.; ‘m(ake) bold to say’ pragalBatayA vad 1 P or vacanasAhasaM kf
Ⓝ[Make] for,ⒶaBi-yA 2 P, pratiyA, upasfp-upagam 1 P, aBi-upa-sf 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 Avah 1 P, kxp 1 A.
Ⓝ[Make] into,ⒶnirmA, vi-DA; ‘gold is made into ornaments’ suvarRasyAlaMkArAH kriyaMte.
Ⓝ[Make] of,ⒶSee Make (5) above; ‘made of’ maya (yI f.), Gawita, nirmita, Atmaka, rUpa in comp.; or only by comp.; ‘a pot made of gold’ hemanirmitaM pAtraM, hemapAtraM.
Ⓑ
 2 avagam 1 P; buD 1 P; ‘not knowing what to m(ake) of it’ kiM nu etatsyAditi jYAtumasamarTAH.
Ⓝ[Make] off,ⒶpalAy 1 A, apakram, apa-i, apa-sf-gam-DAv 1 P.
Ⓝ[Make] out,ⒶnirUp 10, jYA 9 U, avagam, grah 9 U, upalaB 1 A, vid 2 P; See Know.
Ⓑ
 2 pratipad c., samarT 10; pramARIkf, sAD c., nizpad c.
Ⓝ[Make] over,Ⓐsam-f c. (arpayati), saMkram c., nikzip 6 P, nyas 4 U, AyattIkf.
Ⓝ[Make] up,ⒶsamAhf 1 P, saMkal 10, saMBf 1 P, 3 U, samA-nI 1 P, ekIkf.
Ⓑ
 2 (A loss) pUr, prativi-DA; ‘you should m(ake) up for your want of beauty by being good’ tvayA alAvaRyadozaH sadAcaraRena prativiDeyaH.
Ⓑ
 3 (A quarrel) saM-DA, praSam c., (praSama-yasi vivAdaM S. 5).
Ⓑ
 4 nirRI, sAD, nizpad c.; ‘m(ake) up oneʼs mind’ nirRI, niSci 5 U; See Determine; ‘m(ake) up to’ upasf, upa-gam; See Approach.
Ⓔs.ⒹAkAraH, Akfti f., rUpaM, vigrahaH, aMgaM, vapus n.; ‘handsomeness of m(ake up)’ aMga-sOzWavaM.
Ⓝ[Mak]er,Ⓒs.ⒹkAraH, karaH, kArin, kft in comp.; kartf m., nirmAtf m. viDAtf m., kalpakaH, racakaH, GawakaH; ‘m(aker) of pots’ kuMBakAraH-kft &c.
Ⓑ
 2 Creator, q. v. ‘man is the m(aker) of his own fortune’ loke gurutvaM viparItatAM vA svacezwitAnyeva naraM nayaMti (H. 2).
Ⓝ[Mak]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹkaraRaM, viDAnaM, racanaM, kalpanaM, nirmARaM, &c.
